column1: LIVE FIRE: these bots shoot back and every round is harder. Clear every round. Crouch behind crates (C) and dash through shots (ALT).
column2: 实弹对抗：这些机器人会还击，而且每一轮都更难。清空每一轮。蹲在箱子后面（C），并用冲刺（Alt）躲开子弹。

column1: Two gunners hold their ground and two rushers run at you. Close in and swing before they lunge.
column2: 两名枪手坚守阵地，两名冲锋者向你冲来。贴近并在它们扑上来之前挥击。

column1: Heavy melee: one slow, crushing blow. Close in and swing with left click.
column2: 重型近战：一记缓慢而沉重的重击。贴近目标，用左键挥击。
